svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 375 AI-attributed commits, 463 AI actor presences across 58 active AI days (author dates), 7 AI providers. Collaboration terrain 2026-04-22 to 2026-07-14, peak day 12 commits; height is total commits, hue is the day's AI share; publishable repositories only. Generated 2026-07-14.
